hypothesis: Broad refill lowers point group count/CPU but delays large DATA submission and loses SSD batch throughput. Restrict refill to small DATA groups and reuse the lock needed to publish endpoint metadata; keep original large-only packing path.
change: After framing, acquire the existing endpoint admission guard. Only for initialize_extents=true groups below eight tickets take one snapshot of queued work. If it adds work, release admission for framing and reacquire for endpoint publication; otherwise use the original guard. Large-only groups do not refill. No wait, timer, repeated refill, codec or durability change.
protocol: Same audited four-arm protocol as buffered-isolated plan: four warmups; odd retained v4/candidate v4/retained v7/candidate v7, even reverse; 1KiB values;2GiB SST; sample every100 point or10 batch;30sec initial SSD cooldown,10sec between runs. Preserve all scores and stalled runs. No builds/tests/profiles during scoring; one-second host audit.
ssd_guards: Both workloads raw/normalized/arm-median throughput >=0.95 and paired p99 <=1.10; at least one raw >=1.02 and normalized >=1.00.
conditional_ram: If initial SSD guards pass: three four-arm pairs each of tmpfs batch64 750000puts/8writers,point8 100000,point1 100000. Raw/normalized/arm-median throughput >=0.95,CPU <=1.05,and solo p99 <=1.10.
confirmation: If both phases pass: exactly five further SSD pairs per workload;pool only this candidate initial+confirmation,require SSD rules still pass. No extra attempts selected by score.
rejection: Revert if fixed guards fail;retain exact patch,source manifest,binary identity,and all captures. Never pool buffering experiments or historical different-length cells.
